entries.title: Ezekiel 20:1
segments:
vv 1-44. 
 
Though God will be inquired of by his people for the blessings which he promises, yet the hope of his cause rests not on their constancy, but upon his own unchangeable fidelity to his promises and zeal for his great name.  For his own glory he has begun and will carry forward the work of redemption, separating the wicked who are among his people from the righteous by his repeated judgments, and thus continuing and enlarging his kingdom from age to age.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:7
segments: And defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt; when God came to deliver his people from Egypt, he found them pollute with the worship of its idols, and deserving of his wrath.  How deep was this moral infection appears from the narrative of the golden calf,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:23
segments: Would scatter them among the heathen;

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:25
segments: I gave them also statutes--not good; in a permissive sense.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:26
segments: Caused to pass through the fire; as burnt-offerings to their gods,

. 
 
  All that openeth the womb; all their first-born children; a horrid perversion of the divine ordinance,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:29
segments: What is the high place whereunto ye go? a question of indignant remonstrance.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:35
segments: The wilderness of the people; figuratively spoken, a wilderness consisting of exile and oppression among foreigners, in which the wheat shall be sifted from the chaff.  In restoring his people from captivity, God will repeat to them the discipline to which he subjected their fathers in the literal wilderness, and by which he destroyed the rebellious from among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:37
segments: To pass under the rod; as shepherds do their flocks, thus numbering and reviewing each sheep of the fold, and separating the evil from the good.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:38
segments: I will bring them forth--shall not enter into the land of Israel; another allusion to the exodus from Egypt: God will deal with the rebels among the captives as he did with the rebellious generation whom he brought out of Egypt.  Compare

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:39
segments: Go ye, serve--with your idols; be wholly devoted to your gods, or serve me wholly: mix not your idolatrous rites with my worship.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:40
segments:
vv 40-44. 
 
  For in my holy mountain--your corrupt doings; a promise to the purified remnant, to be progressively fulfulled from age to age.  See note on

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:45
segments:
The word of the Lord came unto me; the remainder of this chapter properly belongs to the following. 
 
vv 45-48. God would not spare his own chosen city Jerusalem from the devouring flame and from captivity, when she persisted in rebelling against him; neither will he spare any of his churches at the present day who follow her example, on account of the greatness of the privileges which he has conferred upon them in times past, or on account of the piety of their forefathers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:46
segments: The forest of the south field; Jerusalem, with the region dependent upon her,
.  The multitude of her people is represented under the similitude of a forest.  Compare
